fixed: Importing a Caller's Companion .USR file again no longer clears the pay, Perform dialect, event rules or calendar link of the programs it updates. Like the venue, times and archived state, which it already kept, they can't be written in a .USR file, so the program keeps them.
A Caller's Companion dance whose name holds a very long run of spaces no longer holds up the import for minutes.

CallersCompanionUsrImporter.commit rebuilds a re-imported program from the stored one and takes from the file only what a .USR file says (and the Draft status, as before), so dialectName, pay, eventRuleIds and the calendar fields (calendarEventKey, calendarEventFingerprint, calendarWrittenAt, calendarFlag) are kept, and so is a field Program gains later.

splitCcNameTail finds the gap before a Name's date in time linear in the Name's length; one pattern with two whitespace quantifiers sharing a run backtracked cubically over a long run of spaces no year follows.
